The '''Battle of Rodia''' was a battle fought sometime during the [[Jedi Civil War]].

==History==
During both the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and the [[Mandalorian Wars]], [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] managed to remain neutral, but during the [[Jedi Civil War]], it was finally drawn into the full-scale conflict. In hopes to deny the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] its greatest source of [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces attempted to destroy the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] using the massive firepower of the [[Star Forge]] fleet. But the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] uncovered their plot and signaled the Republic fleet for help. The Battle of Rodia was an important battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]], and after the Republic drove away the Sith fleet, Rodia officially joined the war on the Republic side, though individual [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] mercenaries continued to work for the Sith and other factions.<ref name="KOTORCG" /> From Rodia, the Republic launched a campaign which resulted in victories at [[Battle of Mon Gazza (Jedi Civil War)|Mon Gazza]] and [[Battle of the Lannik system (Jedi Civil War)|Lannik]].<ref name="EA" />
